learning_outcomes.text: Students become closely acquainted with the working areas of the chemical engineering program, and increase their business experience by engaging in applications that reinforce the knowledge and skills they have gained during their studies.
Students gain a sense of professional duty and responsibility.
Students gain the ability to work in a harmonious team with business personnel and develop effective communication skills.
Students recognize technological developments in their field and gain the ability to evaluate industrial applications, prepare reports, and present them.

syllabus_topics: The course content is created by the in-business training personnel and the responsible faculty member of the department, according to the activities the student will carry out in the business as part of vocational training.
